specs.name: majorityElement_singleton
specs.stmt:
∀ (x : Int) (h_precond : majorityElement_precond [x]),
    majorityElement [x] h_precond = x

specs.name: majorityElement_all_same
specs.stmt: theorem majorityElement_all_same : ∀ (x : Int) (n : Nat) (h_precond : majorityElement_precond (List.replicate (n + 1) x)), majorityElement (List.replicate (n + 1) x) h_precond = x

specs.name: majorityElement_mem
specs.stmt:
∀ (nums : List Int) (h_precond : majorityElement_precond nums),
    majorityElement nums h_precond ∈ nums

specs.name: majorityElement_count_gt_half
specs.stmt:
∀ (nums : List Int) (h_precond : majorityElement_precond nums),
    nums.count (majorityElement nums h_precond) > nums.length / 2

specs.name: majorityElement_others_le_half
specs.stmt:
∀ (nums : List Int) (h_precond : majorityElement_precond nums),
    ∀ x ∈ nums, x ≠ majorityElement nums h_precond →
    nums.count x ≤ nums.length / 2

specs.name: majorityElement_count_dominates
specs.stmt: theorem majorityElement_count_dominates : ∀ (nums : List Int) (h_precond : majorityElement_precond nums), ∀ x ∈ nums, x ≠ majorityElement nums h_precond → nums.count x < nums.count (majorityElement nums h_precond)

specs.name: majorityElement_count_pos
specs.stmt: theorem majorityElement_count_pos : ∀ (nums : List Int) (h_precond : majorityElement_precond nums), nums.count (majorityElement nums h_precond) > 0

specs.name: majorityElement_count_more_than_half_length
specs.stmt: theorem majorityElement_count_more_than_half_length : ∀ (nums : List Int) (h_precond : majorityElement_precond nums), 2 * nums.count (majorityElement nums h_precond) > nums.length

specs.name: majorityElement_unique
specs.stmt: theorem majorityElement_unique : ∀ (nums : List Int) (h_precond : majorityElement_precond nums), ∀ y : Int, nums.count y > nums.length / 2 → y = majorityElement nums h_precond

specs.name: majorityElement_replicate_idempotent
specs.stmt: theorem majorityElement_replicate_idempotent : ∀ (nums : List Int) (h_precond : majorityElement_precond nums), let r

specs.name: majorityElement_perm_invariant
specs.stmt: theorem majorityElement_perm_invariant : ∀ (nums : List Int) (h_precond : majorityElement_precond nums) (nums' : List Int) (h_perm : List.Perm nums nums') (h_precond' : majorityElement_precond nums'), majorityElement nums h_precond = majorityElement nums' h_precond'

specs.name: majorityElement_meets_postcond
specs.stmt: theorem majorityElement_meets_postcond : ∀ (nums : List Int) (h : majorityElement_precond nums), majorityElement_postcond nums (majorityElement nums h) h

specs.name: majorityElement_some_case_count
specs.stmt: theorem majorityElement_some_case_count : ∀ (nums : List Int) (counts : Std.HashMap Int Nat) (k : Int) (c : Nat), counts.toList.find? (fun (_, c) => c > nums.length / 2) = some (k, c) → c > nums.length / 2

specs.name: majorityElement_some_case_result
specs.stmt:
∀ (nums : List Int) (counts : HashMap Int Nat) (k : Int) (c : Nat),
    counts.toList.find? (fun (_, cv) => cv > nums.length / 2) = some (k, c) →
    (match counts.toList.find? (fun (_, cv) => cv > nums.length / 2) with
     | some (k, _) => k
     | none => 0) = k

specs.name: majorityElement_none_returns_zero
specs.stmt: theorem majorityElement_none_returns_zero : ∀ (nums : List Int) (h_precond : majorityElement_precond nums) (counts : Std.HashMap Int Nat), counts.toList.find? (fun (_, c) => c > nums.length / 2) = none → (match counts.toList.find? (fun (_, c) => c > nums.length / 2) with | some (k, _) => k | none => 0) = 0

specs.name: majorityElement_none_violates_postcond
specs.stmt: theorem majorityElement_none_violates_postcond : ∀ (nums : List Int) (h_precond : majorityElement_precond nums) (counts : Std.HashMap Int Nat), counts.toList.find? (fun (_, c) => c > nums.length / 2) = none → (match counts.toList.find? (fun (_, c) => c > nums.length / 2) with | some (k, _) => k | none => 0) = 0 → ∃ x ∈ nums, nums.count x > nums.length / 2
